Prevention: Use basil as a trap crop to attract male fruit flies
Bag the young fruit or use netting to protect fruits from egg laying fruit flies
Use mix crop in the farm (i.e. intercrop)
Sanitation - remove and destroy fallen fruit since it acts as a host.
Bury at least 15 cm deep in the soil
Monitoring: Monitor every day for signs of damage
Look for signs of infestation which include dot-like scars
Fruit flies lay their eggs inside the skin of the fruit and the larvae (maggots) feed inside the fruit, rotten and fallen fruit.
Monitor adult fruit fly using traps.
Direct Control: Pick damaged fruit, remove from field and destroy
Large number of traps are needed
